zh.headline:
阅读、批注、整理。
直接在 ChatGPT 里完成。
zh.intro: AI-MarkDone 为 ChatGPT 添加阅读器、Markdown 复制、公式工具和资料库。读到重要内容，可以高亮、写注释或保存书签；需要带走时，导出为 Markdown、PDF 或图片。
zh.note: 免费开源 · 支持 Chrome 与 Firefox

sections.label: 阅读器
sections.title: 长回答，按自己的节奏读。
sections.body: 把一条回答放进独立的阅读窗口。通过标题大纲找到要看的部分，用上一条、下一条切换回答；需要对照前文时，把片段放进左侧摘录区。
points: 标题大纲：点击标题，跳到回答中的对应位置。
摘录区：暂存段落、公式或代码，边读边对照。
阅读设置：调整字号、宽度和打开方式。
sections.alt: 阅读器中的 DFT 公式与 DFT、FFT 计算量对比表

sections.label: 高亮与注释
sections.title: 标出重点，把问题写在原文旁。
sections.body: 在 ChatGPT 原页面或阅读器中选中内容，标记高亮，或者添加注释。想让 ChatGPT 继续解释时，把原文引用和注释一起整理到输入框，检查后再发送。
points: 高亮：为要复习的内容标记颜色，在资料库中集中查找。
注释：记录修改意见、疑问或自己的理解。
保存方式：高亮会保存；新建注释是否长期保存，由设置决定。

sections.label: 公式工具
sections.title: 写公式时看预览，用公式时直接导出。
sections.body: 在 ChatGPT 输入框内输入 LaTeX，可以补全命令并查看公式预览。回答中的公式也能单独复制或保存，用于笔记、论文和演示文稿。
points: 输入公式：在 $…$ 或 $$…$$ 中输入反斜杠，选择补全项。
实时预览：随着文字光标移动，查看当前公式的排版。
复制与保存：按需使用 LaTeX、PNG、SVG 或 MathML。
sections.alt: 输入框中的 LaTeX 命令补全候选

sections.label: 资料库
sections.title: 书签、注释和高亮，集中整理。
sections.body: 保存需要反复查看的回答，在资料库中按文件夹组织、搜索和预览。高亮与已保存注释也有各自的列表，可以回到原对话继续阅读。
points: 书签：消息书签保存提问与回答快照；页面书签保存名称和网址。
查找：搜索资料，预览保存的内容。
返回原文：从条目回到 ChatGPT；原对话仍需可访问。
sections.alt: 资料库中的 FFT 示例书签与操作入口

sections.label: 复制与导出
sections.title: 带走一段，也能保存多条回答。
sections.body: 复制整条回答，或只复制选中的 Markdown 片段。需要归档或分享时，选择多条消息，导出为 Markdown、PDF 或 PNG。Markdown 离线 ZIP 可把支持的图表、卡片保存为静态附件。
points: Markdown：保留标题、列表、代码与公式，方便继续编辑。
PDF 与 PNG：按所选范围导出，适合阅读和分享。
图表与卡片：在 PDF、PNG 中保留为图片，或使用文字占位。
sections.alt: 选择消息并配置 Markdown、PDF 和 PNG 导出

zh.moreTitle: 还有这些日常会用到的工具。

more.title: 消息目录
more.body: 查看对话中的消息列表，跳到需要的回答。

more.title: 发送后保持位置
more.body: 发送消息后，按设置保留当前阅读位置。

more.title: 选择工具栏
more.body: 在选中文字旁打开复制、注释和高亮操作。

more.title: 工具按钮设置
more.body: 选择要显示的按钮，以及悬浮或常显方式。

more.title: 提示词与注释模板
more.body: 复用常用提问方式，调整原文与注释的组合格式。

more.title: 资料库备份
more.body: 导出本地备份，或连接 Google Drive 后手动备份。

zh.privacyBody: 书签、高亮和已保存的注释存放在扩展的本地存储。需要换设备时，你可以导出资料库；也可以连接自己的 Google Drive 账号，再手动点击立即备份。
zh.helpBody: 工作流展示阅读、批注、保存和导出的完整操作。手册用于查找单项功能、配置与常见问题。
zh.closeTitle: 安装后，刷新 ChatGPT 即可开始。

en.headline:
Read, annotate, and organize.
Right inside ChatGPT.
en.intro: AI-MarkDone adds a reader, Markdown copying, formula tools, and a library to ChatGPT. Highlight useful passages, add notes, or save bookmarks. Export the answers you need as Markdown, PDF, or images.
en.note: Free and open source · Chrome and Firefox

sections.label: Reader
sections.title: Read long answers at your own pace.
sections.body: Open an answer in a separate reading window. Use its heading outline to find a section, move between answers, and keep earlier passages in the excerpts panel while you read.
points: Heading outline: jump to a section of the answer.
Excerpts: keep passages, formulas, or code beside the text temporarily.
Reader settings: adjust text size, width, and how Reader opens.
sections.alt: The DFT formula and a table comparing DFT and FFT operation counts in Reader

sections.label: Highlights and annotations
sections.title: Mark a passage. Leave your question beside it.
sections.body: Select text on the ChatGPT page or in Reader to highlight it or add a note. To ask a follow-up, insert the source text and annotations into the composer, review them, and send.
points: Highlights: color passages to revisit and find them in Library.
Annotations: record edits, questions, or your own interpretation.
Saving: highlights are saved; a setting controls whether new annotations are kept permanently.

sections.label: Formula tools
sections.title: Preview formulas as you write. Export them when you need them.
sections.body: Complete LaTeX commands and preview formulas in the ChatGPT composer. You can also copy or save individual formulas from answers for notes, papers, and presentations.
points: Write: type a backslash inside $…$ or $$…$$ to choose a completion.
Preview: see the formula at the text cursor as you type or move through it.
Copy and save: use LaTeX, PNG, SVG, or MathML as needed.
sections.alt: LaTeX command suggestions in the ChatGPT composer

sections.label: Library
sections.title: Keep bookmarks, annotations, and highlights together.
sections.body: Save answers you want to revisit. Organize them into folders, search, and preview their content. Highlights and saved annotations have their own lists, with links back to the original conversation.
points: Bookmarks: message bookmarks keep a question-and-answer snapshot; page bookmarks keep a name and URL.
Find: search your library and preview saved content.
Return: open the original ChatGPT conversation, provided it is still accessible.
sections.alt: An FFT example bookmark and its actions in Library

sections.label: Copy and export
sections.title: Take a passage or save several answers.
sections.body: Copy a whole answer or a selected Markdown passage. For archiving or sharing, select messages and export Markdown, PDF, or PNG. Offline Markdown ZIP can include supported charts and cards as static attachments.
points: Markdown: keep headings, lists, code, and formulas for further editing.
PDF and PNG: export the selected messages for reading or sharing.
Charts and cards: keep supported content as images in PDF and PNG, or use text placeholders.
sections.alt: Message selection and Markdown, PDF, and PNG export options

more.title: Message directory
more.body: Browse the conversation and jump to the answer you need.

more.title: Keep your reading position
more.body: Choose to keep your current position after sending a message.

more.title: Selection toolbar
more.body: Copy, annotate, and highlight beside selected text.

more.title: Button settings
more.body: Choose visible buttons and whether they appear on hover or stay visible.

more.title: Prompts and annotation templates
more.body: Reuse common requests and change how source text and notes are combined.

more.title: Library backup
more.body: Export a local backup or connect Google Drive and back up manually.

en.privacyTitle: Your library stays in your browser.
en.privacyBody: Bookmarks, highlights, and saved annotations are stored locally by the extension. To move devices, export your library or connect your own Google Drive account and choose Back up now manually.
en.helpBody: Workflows show complete reading, annotation, saving, and export tasks. Use the manual to look up individual features, settings, and common questions.
en.closeTitle: Install, then refresh ChatGPT to begin.
